message.name: SAIL_MOTOR_TEST
message.description: Bench-only timed sail motor command. Source must be system 1/component 1. Target is system 1/component 154. Command IDs must increase within an MCU boot. Moves while busy are rejected; stop can interrupt a move. This is unsigned MAVLink 2 over one raw I2C write.
message.field: Nonzero increasing ID. Read status and use its last accepted ID plus one.
Motor energisation duration, 1 through 5000 for a move, zero for stop.
PWM duty 1 through 128 out of 255 for a move, zero for stop.

message.name: SAIL_MOTOR_TEST_STATUS
message.description: Bench-only status. Returned as a MAVLink 2 frame padded with zeros to a fixed 32-byte I2C read. Elapsed time is MCU motor energisation time, not measured shaft movement. Rejections leave command_id pointing to the last accepted command.
message.field: Last accepted command ID; zero at boot.
Time energised for the last accepted move, frozen at stop.
Time remaining in the current move.
0 idle, 1 running, 2 completed, 3 explicitly stopped, 4 receive overflow stop.
Current output direction; zero when stopped.
Current output PWM; zero when stopped.
0 accepted/normal, 1 invalid fields, 2 busy, 3 stale/duplicate ID, 4 bad frame, 5 receive overflow, 6 wrong source/target.
